formats.key: Permit(address holder,address spender,uint256 nonce,uint256 expiry,bool allowed)
effects: Sets the signer's DAI allowance for `spender` to unlimited (uint(-1)) when `allowed` is true.
Sets the signer's DAI allowance for `spender` to 0 when `allowed` is false, which revokes any existing allowance.
The signature can be submitted by anyone until `expiry`; `expiry` = 0 means it never expires.
Uses up the signer's current permit nonce, so any older signed permit with that nonce becomes invalid.
formats.shown: The screen reads 'Authorize spending of tokens' and shows the spender as a raw address, 'Unlimited spending' as a raw true/false, and 'Valid until' as a date. The date is hidden when expiry is 0.

findings.title: DAI Permit with allowed=false sets the allowance to 0, but the screen still says 'Authorize spending'.
findings.evidence: dai.sol Dai.permit: `uint wad = allowed ? uint(-1) : 0; allowance[holder][spender] = wad;`. Descriptor: intent "Authorize spending of tokens", field `allowed` label 'Unlimited spending', format raw. A signer who sees 'Unlimited spending: false' can read it as a limited grant. The real effect is a revoke.
findings.fix: Add an enum on `allowed` with {"true": "Unlimited DAI", "false": "Revoke (0)"}. Label it 'Allowance', show it with format enum, and change the intent to 'Approve or revoke DAI spending'.

findings.title: DAI Permit hides the expiry field when expiry is 0, so a permit that never expires shows no validity limit.
findings.evidence: dai.sol Dai.permit: `require(expiry == 0 || now <= expiry, "Dai/permit-expired");`. Descriptor field `expiry` has visible {"ifNotIn": [0, "0"]}. Case 1 (expiry "0") shows only Spender and 'Unlimited spending'. Nothing on the screen says the signature stays valid forever.
findings.fix: Keep `expiry` always visible and render 0 as 'No expiry', for example with a threshold or message, or add a fixed notice field when expiry is 0.

findings.title: DAI Permit intent says 'tokens' and never names DAI or the unlimited amount.
findings.evidence: Descriptor intent "Authorize spending of tokens"; no field names the token. dai.sol: `string public constant symbol = "DAI";` and `uint wad = allowed ? uint(-1) : 0;`. The asset is shown only through the owner 'Dai Stablecoin v2.0'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Approve unlimited DAI spending', or add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Allow {spender} to spend your DAI'.

findings.title: DAI Permit shows the spender as a raw hex address instead of a resolved name.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `spender` has format "raw". In cases 0 and 1 the screen shows '0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D', which is the Uniswap V2 Router.
findings.fix: Use format addressName with types ["contract","eoa"] for `spender`.

findings.title: DAI Permit tests never use allowed=false, the revoke path that changes what the screen should say.
findings.evidence: Cases 0 and 1 both use `"allowed": true`. dai.sol Dai.permit sets the allowance to 0 when allowed is false.
findings.fix: Add a test case with `allowed: false` and the expected revoke rendering.

Permit(address holder,address spender,ui.worst: DAI Permit hides the expiry field when expiry is 0, so a permit that never expires shows no validity limit.

summary.worst: DAI Permit hides the expiry field when expiry is 0, so a permit that never expires shows no validity limit.
